admission.dataset: IRI; one nonempty string DOI/source identifier and at least one explicitly typed release
admission.release: IRI; one nonempty public identifier; exactly one owning dataset and at least one typed source record
admission.record: IRI; one canonical JSON [release public ID, integer row, opaque nonempty source hash] identifier; one row, hash and owning release; zero or one typed run
admission.activity: IRI; one nonempty public identifier and at least one generated record; a run is optional
admission.local_kind_separation: Focused nodes cannot have more than one of the four M1 export types; not an added universal OWL disjointness axiom
admission.identity: Existing percent-encoded M1 instance IRI and composite key rules; no global owl:sameAs inference
admission.hash_bound: Opaque nonempty string; no digest algorithm inferred

query.source: Exact PAIR_SPARQL from historical M1; fixture golden tuples frozen separately

license.authority: Approved D-03; preserve source attribution; no external asset/runtime relicense

limits: Synthetic profile witnesses only; copied-W6 integration is the next separate packet
No new SQL schema migration or published RC modification
Formal OWL existence and profile data admission remain distinct
